title: Hit the Surf Charters

services.name: Book Paddleboard...
services.desc: Planning my trip to Avalon, New Jersey this summer was thrilling. The thought of exploring the breathtaking coastline had me counting down the days. Friends shared glowing stories about the paddleboarding scene, and I was eager to join in. Yet, a big question loomed large: How could I enjoy paddleboarding without the chaos of transporting bulky equipment? The answer was simple: an inflatable paddleboard. In this post, I will explain why opting for an inflatable paddleboard enhanced my rental experience and why it's an excellent option for anyone visiting Avalon, NJ. Paddleboarding has risen in popularity, providing a fantastic way to enjoy the outdoors. Avalon is a haven for this sport,

services.name: Kids Fishing
services.desc: KIDS FISHING CHARTER is all about having fun! This fishing trip with kids is geared toward kids that are new to fishing. ​The focus is on catching numbers of fish versus trying to go for a BIGGUN! Going for BIG fish generally takes more time and patience, which even for the seasoned angler can be tough some times. (But that's fishing!) So, the goal is to introduce them to fishing by having them catch as much as possible! The back bay of Avalon, NJ is a fun, safe environment that offers a great introduction to the sport of fishing, while only being minutes from the dock at Avalon Marine Center in Avalon

services.name: Booze Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a nice relaxing evening with family or friends, cruising the intracoastal waterway behind Avalon and Stone Harbor and experience what the 7 mile island has to offer from the water! The views behind Avalon/Stone Harbor are beautiful, but watching the sunset on the Delaware Bay is one of the best places to view a South Jersey sunset!
